content.thinking: 10500 prefixes exceeds the 8192 bound → the front end rejects → invalid request ✓ correct behavior (my test's fault). Let me reduce to ≤ 8192 distinct prefixes and also mind the 4096 front key bounds.

arguments.command:
cd /workspace/tmp && python3 - <<'PY'
import json, random, sys, time
sys.path.insert(0,'/workspace/tmp')
import cli, pyref
binary=cli.build()
rng=random.Random(101)
d={}
G=1000
for g in range(G):
    base = (g*7919+13) & 0xFFFFFFFFFFFF
    hi = (0x2001 << 48) | base
    for k,length in enumerate(range(70,125,6)):
        lo = (k+1) << (63-k)
        hi2, lo2 = pyref.norm(hi, lo, length)
        key=(hi2,lo2,length)
        if len(d)>=8000: break
        d[key]=(g*7+k) % 4194303
print('prefixes',len(d), 'front64 keys', len(set(k[0] for k in d if k[2]>=65)))
ops=[['put','%016x%016x'%(k[0],k[1]),k[2],v] for k,v in d.items()]+[['save'],['load_saved',0]]
addrs=['%016x%016x'%(rng.getrandbits(64),rng.getrandbits(64)) for _ in range(2000)]
ops+=[['image_query',addrs]]
t=time.time(); res=cli.results({'cases':[{'ops':ops}]},binary)[0]; dt=time.time()-t
snap=res['snapshots'][0]
print('time %.2fs rows %d cells %s bitmaps %d ni %d json %d'%(dt,sum(len(b) for b in snap['banks']),snap['cells'],len(snap['bitmaps']),len(snap['nexthops']),len(json.dumps(snap))))
got=pyref.validate(snap)
print('pyref ok, same set:', got=={(k[0],k[1],k[2]):v for k,v in d.items()}, 'loads',res['loads'])
m=pyref.Fib()
for k,v in d.items(): m.put(k[0],k[1],k[2],v)
exp=[m.lookup_upto(int(a[:16],16),int(a[16:],16)) for a in addrs]
print('answers match', res['answers']==exp)
PY
